App.description: An AI secretary that finds the trips on your calendar, arranges them and pays for them. The payments and the age check run on Midnight.

Home.title: Home
Home.signedOut: Sign in to see your MST balance and confirmed itineraries.

balance.title: MST you hold
balance.note: A stand-in figure until the balance lookup lands.

trips.title: Confirmed itineraries
trips.empty: No itinerary has been confirmed yet.

TasksPage.title: Tasks
TasksPage.scanHelper: Reads the next 30 days of your calendar and lists the events that are not arranged yet.
TasksPage.notScanned: Scan the calendar to see the events you can arrange.
TasksPage.route: {from} to {to} · {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}}

ProfileSettings.title: Profile
ProfileSettings.description: The AI secretary uses these settings to decide where you travel from, what to suggest, and which identity checks you can satisfy.
ProfileSettings.newProfileNotice: Nothing is saved yet. Choose a home city and save to get started.

hints.email: Taken from the account you signed in with. It cannot be changed here.
hints.address: Shown for reference only. It is not used to work out travel times or identity checks.
hints.verification: The values you enter here are not disclosed. Only the proof that you meet a condition is presented.
hints.birthDate: Used for the age check. Without it, services that require one are left out of suggestions.
hints.residencePref: Used for the residence check, such as discounts limited to local residents.
hints.home: The options come from the transport services that are currently registered.
hints.genres: Up to {max}. Matched against the genre of each restaurant and leisure service.
hints.budget: Used as a hard limit when the secretary filters options.
hints.priority: Decides how options are weighted when the secretary picks one.
hints.wallet: The address the secretary pays from. Service providers have their own addresses, which are the ones that receive money.
hints.walletAddress: Connect a Midnight-compatible wallet extension to fill this in. It is not typed by hand.

wallet.notFound: No Midnight-compatible wallet extension was found in this browser.
wallet.rejected: The connection request was rejected in the wallet.
wallet.disconnected: The wallet connection was lost. Try connecting again.
wallet.failed: Could not connect to the wallet.

ageCredential.title: Age credential
ageCredential.description: Issue a credential that proves only that you meet an age requirement, computed from your date of birth. The date of birth itself never reaches the other party.
ageCredential.needsBirthDate: Register your date of birth first
ageCredential.unavailable: The credential's status could not be read.

details.memory: This credential lives in memory and is not on Midnight

readiness.title: What these settings unlock
readiness.description: Services that require an identity check are only suggested when the matching detail is filled in.

note.age: Enter your date of birth to include services with an age limit.
note.residence: Enter your prefecture to include resident-only rates.

errors.conflict: This profile was changed somewhere else. Reload and try again.
errors.notFound: This profile no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.failed: The profile could not be saved.

field.birthDate: Enter a valid date that is not in the future.
field.residencePref: Choose one of the listed options.
field.homeSpot: Choose one of the listed options.
field.budget: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
field.priority: Choose one of the listed options.
field.walletAddress: Connect a wallet, or disconnect to leave it empty.

ServiceManagement.title: Service management
ServiceManagement.description: Manage the transport, hotel, restaurant, and leisure services used by the AI secretary.
ServiceManagement.loadFailed: The service list could not be loaded.
ServiceManagement.selectDescription: Select a service on the left to see its summary. These destinations are currently supported.
ServiceManagement.formComingNext: The registration and editing form will be added to this area in the next implementation stage.

detail.failed: The service details could not be loaded.
detail.notFound: This service no longer exists. Reload the list.
detail.doorToDoorNote: Includes access to and from the station or airport, and time spent waiting before boarding.

Conversation.title: Arranging {title}
Conversation.noEvent: This event is not in the next 30 days of your calendar.
Conversation.noMandate: The allowance is set up with the first proposal.

lines.greeting: Hello. I can help arrange "{title}". The spending allowance covers up to {cap}.
lines.ask: Shall I arrange this event as a business trip?
lines.proposal: Here is my plan. The total is {total}.
lines.askProof: {place} asks for age verification ({age}+). May I send the age proof? Your birth date stays private; the proof only shows that you are {age} or older.
lines.ageRejected: You are not yet {age} as of {date}, so {place} is not available. May I rebuild the plan from the places with no age limit?
lines.ageVerified: Proved that you are {age} or older as of {date}.
lines.askPay: Shall I pay for it from the allowance?
lines.partiallyPaid: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} already paid. Shall I pay for the rest?
lines.paid: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} authorized and settled from the allowance.
lines.askWriteBack: Shall I add the trip to your calendar?
lines.written: The trip is on your calendar.
lines.confirmedStoreFailed: Saving the confirmed itinerary failed. The calendar entry is already in place.

working.approveWithProof: Proving your age and recording your approval...
working.replan: Rebuilding the plan from the places with no age limit...
working.pay: Generating the zero-knowledge proof and paying...
working.writeBack: Writing the trip to the calendar...

lines.failed: Sorry, that did not go through.

echo.approvePartlyPrivate: I approve the plan ({count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} kept private).
echo.writeBack: Please add it to my calendar.

LedgerPanel.title: Two ledgers, one payment
LedgerPanel.subtitle: What everyone can see next to what only you can see.

public.title: What the network records
public.who: Anyone can read this through the indexer.
public.note: No amounts, caps, dates, or identities appear here. The hashes prove a payment fit an allowance, nothing more.

private.title: What stays with you
private.who: Only you and your secretary can read this.
private.note: Held off-chain and proven on-chain. The commitment is the only link to the public side.
